| [Investment input pack](SKILL.md) | Agent Skill | Prepare the investment planning input pack once an integration roadmap or a use-case plan is agreed and budget is needed - cost lines per machine or system, the benefit side taken from the benefit case, the gates the spend must pass, and the open figures - so the OD lead and BA Operations can decide. Covers the cost template for a standardized system (Lane 1b), the wave pack after an equipment assessment, and the cost side handed to a capital request (Lane 2 step 5, Lane 3 step 3). It prepares the input; it never approves or commits spend. Use when a roadmap is agreed and the plant asks "what does this cost and who approves it", when an assessment lists machines that need hardware, or before a capital request is written. |
